dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, light-pigmented 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters with diffuse outer gradients transitioning into dark-toned centers; approximately 5 prominent rings are visible along the mid-dorsal and lateral sections with variable edge thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, dark-pigmented solid clusters localized between the lighter macro-annuli; these lack internal gradients and are most concentrated in the posterior-lateral transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an elongated, irregular quadrilateral with its primary axis oriented longitudinally.
